free_tier.stated: EUR 2.60/month for KVM-XS in Velbert, Germany, after coupon LEB35: 4 GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 25 GB disk, 1 TB traffic, 2x 10 Gbit shared uplink, 1 IPv4 and a /64 IPv6, EUR 26.00/year on the annual term after the same coupon. The post's table prices KVM-M at EUR 9.10/month for 12 GB, 4 vCPU and 75 GB, KVM-L at EUR 11.70 for 18 GB, 6 vCPU and 100 GB, and KVM-XXL at EUR 22.75 for 32 GB, 10 vCPU and 250 GB, all with 1 TB traffic. Every figure in the table is a post-coupon figure; the pre-coupon list price is not printed.
